answer: Each identity registers a live source at jetty and locks a 50-credit bond; the source must publish fresh readings per epoch, and no source may back two identities. Auditors check the nebula against the trellis record: a source claimed twice burns both bonds, and silence past the deadline burns its bond. A rented source fails: one owner cannot sign fresh readings for two identities without a duplicate, and revoking it kills the renter. The k-th fake needs its own source and 50 credits, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 sources and 50,000 credits; one honest identity needs a source, keeps its bond.
